name: in-outer-projection
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+1 NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: row-in-outer-projection
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a+1,o.b) IN (SELECT i.x+o.k,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: row-not-in-outer-projection
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE (o.a+1,o.b) NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k,i.y FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-outer-projection-without-filter
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a+o.k IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-without-filter
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.k+5 NOT IN (SELECT i.enabled+o.k FROM inner_rows i) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-empty-input
sql: DELETE FROM inner_rows; SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a NOT IN (SELECT i.x+o.k FROM inner_rows i) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-projection-reads-only-outer-value
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a IN (SELECT o.a FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-projection-reads-only-outer-value
sql: SELECT o.id FROM outer_rows o WHERE o.a NOT IN (SELECT o.a FROM inner_rows i WHERE i.k=o.k AND i.enabled=1) ORDER BY o.id;

name: in-outer-projection-collation
sql: SELECT o.id FROM typed_outer o WHERE o.k IN (SELECT (CASE WHEN o.grp>0 THEN i.k ELSE o.k END) COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) ORDER BY o.id;

name: not-in-outer-projection-collation
sql: SELECT o.id FROM typed_outer o WHERE o.k NOT IN (SELECT (CASE WHEN o.grp>0 THEN i.k ELSE o.k END) COLLATE NOCASE FROM typed_inner i WHERE i.grp=o.grp) ORDER BY o.id;
